'''The Puddle''' was a small settlement on the edge of an [[The Puddle (oasis)|eponymous oasis]] that was located on a remote [[Desert/Legends|desert]] world in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. Run by the [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] [[Tilossa]], the town was mostly ignored by [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Once a [[Standard month/Legends|month]], it held a swap meet that went without restrictions or legal entanglements.<ref name="H&S" />
